sentences.en: You need a specialized tool in order to fix this.
sentences.zh: 你需要专门的工具才能修理这个。

sentences.en: Yanni is a repair technician specialized in repairing windshield.
sentences.zh: Yanni是一名专修挡风玻璃维修的技术员。

sentences.en: Fixing a bullseye in the windshield doesn't require any specialized tools.
sentences.zh: 修复挡风玻璃上的靶心不需要任何特殊工具。

senses.zh: 专攻（specialize的过去分词）；使…专门化；详细说明
